items.name: Costco Wholesale
items.headline: Declares $30 special dividend and reauthorizes $4B buyback
items.catalyst: Nov. 10 release: special cash dividend of $30 per share payable Dec. 4 to holders of record Nov. 24.
items.thesis: The total payment is approximately $13.3 billion. The new repurchase program of up to $4 billion expires in November 2030 and replaces a program under which $3.1 billion had been purchased.

items.name: Steel Dynamics
items.headline: Authorizes additional $3.0B repurchase and declares $0.53 dividend
items.catalyst: Nov. 9 release: board authorized an additional $3.0 billion share repurchase program, effective immediately.
items.thesis: It is additive to the previous $1.5 billion program, which had $216 million remaining on Sept. 30, 2026. The release says the company has repurchased $8.2 billion of its stock since 2017.

items.name: Elevance Health
items.headline: Reaffirms 2026 earnings guidance ahead of investor meetings
items.thesis: Elevance said it will reaffirm full-year 2026 shareholders' earnings of at least $22.00 per diluted share and adjusted earnings of $29.00 or more. The filing restates existing guidance.

items.name: Take-Two
items.headline: Reiterates $8.0-$8.2B fiscal 2027 Net Bookings outlook as Grand Theft Auto VI launch nears
items.catalyst: Fiscal Q2 release (Nov. 9): net revenue $1.50B vs $1.77B; Net Bookings down 18% to $1.60B.
items.thesis: The release lists Grand Theft Auto VI for Nov. 19, 2026 and guides fiscal Q3 Net Bookings to $3.35B-$3.50B.

items.name: Occidental Petroleum
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises and principal debt falls to $10.0B
items.thesis: The company said it reduced principal debt by $1.8 billion to $10.0 billion and generated $4.1 billion of operating cash flow from continuing operations.

items.name: Lucid Group
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 4% as free cash flow consumption falls 30% sequentially
items.thesis: Free cash flow consumption was $1.04 billion and total liquidity $2.0 billion ($3.75 billion pro forma for a $1.75 billion DDTL increase with PIF).
